notablePrerequisites: You control three in any combination of Wizards and/or Soldiers.
description:
Activate Ingris by paying {4}, creating a 2/2 Cadet creature token and giving creatures you control haste until end of turn.
When the Cadet enters, it triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that is a Wizard or Soldier.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Declare all Cadets as attackers. Ingris triggers that many times, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to each opponent.
